welcome.title: Welcome to your learning space
welcome.content: This is your personal development hub. From here you can review progress, continue courses, and move toward your goals.

userMenuTrigger.title: Access to your menu
userMenuTrigger.content: Open your personal menu from here. It's the quick access to profile, certificates, statistics, language, theme, and logout.

userMenuPanel.title: User dropdown menu
userMenuPanel.content: Inside the menu you'll find your personal shortcuts. You can change the platform language or visual theme at any time.

courseFilters.title: Course filters and views
courseFilters.content: Use these controls to switch between grid, list, or learning path views to better organize your study.

learningPaths.title: Your learning paths
learningPaths.content: Paths organize your courses in a logical sequence. You'll be able to see locked, in-progress, and completed courses within each path.

learningPathVideo.title: Path introductory video
learningPathVideo.content: This button opens the introductory video for the path so you understand the global objective of what you are going to learn.

learningPathCourses.title: Courses within the learning path
learningPathCourses.content: Each card shows the course, its position in the path, and if it's available to start or locked by the previous course.

soflia.title: Your SofLIA assistant
soflia.content: SofLIA is here to answer questions, give you context, and support you throughout your learning.

header.title: Your learning statistics
header.content: This panel summarizes your progress, habits, and adoption signals across SofLIA.

ranges.title: Analysis range
ranges.content: Change the period to compare recent activity against wider time windows.

metrics.title: Main metrics
metrics.content: These cards condense progress, AI usage, planning, and overall quality.

courseProgress.title: Progress by course
courseProgress.content: This chart helps you see which courses are moving well and which need attention.

aiAdoption.title: SofLIA adoption
aiAdoption.content: Here you can review how you are using SofLIA assistance during your learning.

feedback.title: Personalized feedback
feedback.content: Generate an AI report to identify strengths, opportunities, and next steps.

heatmap.title: Activity map
heatmap.content: The map shows your interaction patterns so you can spot consistency and quieter periods.

dashboard.title: Business Panel
dashboard.subtitle: Manage your team's learning and oversee their progress.

emptyCourses.title: You don't have assigned courses yet
emptyCourses.description: Your organization will assign you courses soon. In the meantime, explore what we have prepared for you.

dashboard.confirmResetLayout: Are you sure you want to reset the default layout? This will delete your current customization.
